mapper.sql: response_id, defense_id, question_id, question, response_text, response_audio_url, response_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_responses (defense_id, question_id, question, response_text, response_audio_url, response_time) VALUES (#{defenseId}, #{questionId}, #{question}, #{responseText}, #{responseAudioUrl}, COALESCE(#{responseTime}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM voice_responses WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} ORDER BY response_id ASC
